boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct work settings in Blough-Weis Library, selected for documented quiet, collaborative, computer, or reservable-study features.

cards.title: First-Floor Group Work Area
cards.subtitle: Blough-Weis Library · collaborative floor
cards.notes: Set up here when you want conversation-friendly group work; bring headphones if café noise would interrupt your focus.
cards.short_summary: An open, conversation-friendly library floor for working together.
cards.evidence_claim: The library identifies its first floor as designed for group work and conversations.
cards.source_title: Find Your Study Spot at the Library
cards.access_notes: Located inside Blough-Weis Library; the source notes this floor can be loud.

cards.title: Scholarly Grounds Café Seating
cards.subtitle: Blough-Weis Library · main floor
cards.notes: Choose a table for a social study session near the library’s leisure collection; plan around the café’s active atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: Main-floor café seating for a relaxed group work session.
cards.evidence_claim: Scholarly Grounds is on the library’s main floor and is described by the university as a place to study or relax with a group.
cards.source_title: Find Your Study Spot at the Library
cards.access_notes: Inside Blough-Weis Library; café food and drinks may require purchase.

cards.entity_name: Blough-Weis Library First-Floor Group Study Rooms
cards.title: First-Floor Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Blough-Weis Library · reservable group rooms
cards.notes: Reserve a room when your group needs table space, a whiteboard and an HDTV hookup for shared screens or presentations.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms with whiteboards and screen-sharing hardware.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says first-floor group study rooms have HDTV hookups, table space and whiteboards.
cards.source_title: Find Your Study Spot at the Library
cards.access_notes: The source says many library study spaces can be reserved; confirm the room-reservation system before going.

cards.title: First-Floor Computer Stations
cards.subtitle: Blough-Weis Library · open computer seating
cards.notes: Use a library computer when you do not want to carry a laptop; keep materials compact because the source notes limited spread-out space.
cards.short_summary: Open-access computers for a laptop-free work session.
cards.evidence_claim: The university describes several computers throughout the library’s first floor for student use.
cards.source_title: Find Your Study Spot at the Library
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor, which the source characterizes as a group-work and conversation area.

cards.title: First-Floor Study Pods
cards.subtitle: Blough-Weis Library · individual or group pods
cards.notes: Look for a pod when you want a compact setup for solo work or a small group, with the activity of the main floor nearby.
cards.short_summary: Flexible pods for individual work or small-group sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: The university identifies first-floor study pods as spaces for individual or group study.
cards.source_title: Find Your Study Spot at the Library
cards.access_notes: Located on Blough-Weis Library’s first floor; availability is not guaranteed.

cards.title: Second-Floor Quiet Study Area
cards.subtitle: Blough-Weis Library · quiet floor
cards.notes: Head upstairs for a quieter work block when you need sustained reading or writing away from the main floor’s conversations.
cards.short_summary: A library floor designated for quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says the library’s entire second floor is intended as a quiet study space.
cards.source_title: Find Your Study Spot at the Library
cards.access_notes: Inside Blough-Weis Library; follow the quiet-study purpose described by the university.

cards.title: Second-Floor Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Blough-Weis Library · nine reservable rooms
cards.notes: Book one of these rooms for individual or group work when you want an enclosed setting on the library’s quiet-study floor.
cards.short_summary: Nine reservable study rooms on the quiet second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: The university states that the library’s second floor has nine study rooms for individual or group study that can be reserved.
cards.source_title: Find Your Study Spot at the Library
cards.access_notes: Reservation is available through the library room-reservation system, according to the source.

cards.title: Chill Out Rooms
cards.subtitle: Blough-Weis Library · second-floor study rooms
cards.notes: Reserve this adaptive setting if adjustable furniture, softer lighting or sensory tools would make a focused study session more workable.
cards.short_summary: Three reservable rooms with adaptable sensory and seating features.
cards.evidence_claim: The university describes three updated Chill Out study rooms with adjustable tables, dimmable lamps, sound machines and other features.
cards.source_title: Find Your Study Spot at the Library
cards.access_notes: These are among the second-floor study rooms; use the library reservation system referenced by the source.

cards.title: Second-Floor Study Carrels
cards.subtitle: Blough-Weis Library · 32 individual carrels
cards.notes: Take a carrel for a low-distraction reading or writing session, especially when you need a defined individual workspace.
cards.short_summary: Thirty-two individual carrels designed for focused work.
cards.evidence_claim: The university reports 32 individual study carrels on the library’s second floor for focused work with minimal distraction.
cards.source_title: Find Your Study Spot at the Library
cards.access_notes: Located on the library’s quiet-study second floor; availability is not guaranteed.

cards.entity_name: Blough-Weis Library Lower-Level Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Lower-Level Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Blough-Weis Library · lower level
cards.notes: Use a lower-level room when your group needs a whiteboard and table space; check the room system first if you need a scheduled setup.
cards.short_summary: Two lower-level group rooms with whiteboards.
cards.evidence_claim: The university states that the library’s lower level includes two group study rooms with whiteboards.
cards.source_title: Find Your Study Spot at the Library
cards.access_notes: Located in Blough-Weis Library’s lower level; the source says many library spaces can be reserved.
